title: My Former Student Is a Hunk?!
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Hinata, 35, runs an English conversation school from her apartment. A boy she once taught as a child, who proposed to her when he was eight and was told 'maybe when you're eighteen', turns up on his 18th birthday to propose again. The slow-burn romance follows her doubts about the 17-year age gap and her own body image, alongside a rival woman's aggressive advances on him.
life_message: Love should treat the other person as a whole person, not as a fix for one's own insecurities.
